metadata.anti_patterns_rationale: jwt.verify uses node:crypto (not available in edge runtime); document.cookie is DOM (no DOM in middleware); useState is React (no React in middleware); import bcrypt is pure Node (breaks edge)

useState/useEffect would require 'use client' which defeats streaming; 'use client' on a page that's meant to stream means the whole tree turns client; awaiting fetch in the page blocks the render; Promise.all signals over-engineering

fetch( replaces the documented Prisma fetcher — category swap not completion; useEffect is React, this is server-side; Date.now() implies manual cache invalidation defeating unstable_cache; localStorage/setInterval are wrong runtime

useState parallels useOptimistic causing races; useEffect for server-action call is wrong pattern (belongs in startTransition); fetch( bypasses the server action; setOptimistic is a hallucinated API name (no such function returned from useOptimistic)
router.push uses client-side useRouter (not in server action); window.location is DOM; fetch( means action calls itself; useState/useRouter are React hooks unavailable in 'use server' files
